name: Onewo Inc.
summary: Onewo Inc. is a Shenzhen-headquartered property management company in China, founded in 1990 and a subsidiary of China Vanke Co., Ltd. Its three segments are community living consumption services, commercial and urban space services, and AIoT and BPaaS solutions. Residential offerings include cleaning, security, gardening and repairs, plus home brokerage and redecoration, and it also provides smart property technology, supply chain and facility management services.
